planets.name: HD 63935 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 63935 with a 21.4-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 63935 c was found in 2021 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 63935. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
